questions.question:
The given chart shows the marks scored by a class X student in different subjects.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4554e91a8bc121224622a17e408716c3a4f8cea6855a6f69c86945ea1ff1784a.png] 

If the total marks are 1800, then find the difference between the marks scored in science and mathematics.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total marks = 1800

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total degree of marks = 360º

⇒ Marks scored in Science = (82)/(360) × 1800 = 82 × 5 = 410

⇒ Marks scored in Mathematics = (84)/(360) × 1800 = 84 × 5 = 420

⇒ Difference = 420 – 410 = 10

**Therefore, the difference between the marks scored in Mathematics and Science is 10.**

The circle graph given here shows the spending of a country on various sports during a year. Study the graph carefully to answer the question.

Percentage of money spent on various sports for one year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9d60dbcb0adceff02200b8aa16674ccfe5629de7a066a031482c7d2ac99cdf4.png] 

If the total amount spent during the year was ₹1,20,00,000, then how much was spent on Basket Ball?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total amount spent during the year = Rs 1,20,00,000

**Calculation:**

⇒ Percentage of money spent on Basketball = 25%

⇒ Money spent on Basketball = (25)/(100) × 12000000 = 25 × 120000 = Rs 30,00,000

**Therefore, the money spent on Basketball is Rs 30,00,000.**

questions.question:
The following pie chart shows the distribution of income from different taxes. Study the chart and answer the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40637e605effda0e176b764a52bdfadf252d8cd7a1858c4e19a7c7ae40344703.png] 

If the income from the market tax in a year is ₹260 crore, then the total income from other sources is : (in ₹ crore)
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

⇒ Income from the market tax in a year is ₹260 crore

⇒ Let the total income from all the sources be x crores

⇒ Percentage of income from the market tax = 26%

⇒ So, according to the question

⇒(26)/(100) × x = 260 

⇒ x = 260 × (100)/(26) = 1000

⇒ Total income from all the sources = 1000

⇒ Income from other sources other than market tax = 1000 – 260 = 740

**Therefore, the total income from other sources is ₹740 crore.**

questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/276661e64e67d764ba7be040692203d77f54db32db5d7f8b0df818af9d3392d2.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2cbc476b6bdbf587d8478c9d963e0ad4fd7b05c66bb1345ab8a4227a899ede9.png]

questions.question:
The given pie chart shows the percentage of students who enrolled in different hobby classes in a school. The number of students who enrolled in cooking classes is what percentage of those enrolled in dancing classes? (Rounded off to 2 digits after decimal)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43faf4ffb2b5d0c3e54b04a5c7e99836142521d8712f73814afbbee9cbb70e7e.png]
questions.solution:
**Given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43faf4ffb2b5d0c3e54b04a5c7e99836142521d8712f73814afbbee9cbb70e7e.png] 

**Calculation:**

Let the total number of students be 100.

⇒ Number of students in cooking classes = 22% of 100 = (22)/(100) × 100 = 22

⇒ Number of students in dancing classes = 21% of 100 = (21)/(100) × 100 = 21

⇒ Percentage of students compared to each other = (22)/(21) × 100 = 104.76%

**Therefore, number of students who enrolled in cooking classes is 104.76% of those enrolled in dancing classes.**

The given pie chart presents the monthly expenses on the various heads and the savings of Mr. X's family, study the pie chart and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e36400f751c78787c09fbb09885d243ee94bba36ea5fae8f709350b044d00a10.png] 

If the total income of Mr. X is Rs.1,20,000, then how much does he pay for transport?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Total income of Mr. X = Rs. 120000.

**CALCULATION:**

According to the given question, spending on transport = 30°

⇒ 360° = Rs. 120000

⇒ 30° = (120000)/(360^circ) × 30° = Rs. 10,000.

∴ **Mr. X has to pay Rs. 10,000 for the transport.**

questions.question:
The pie chart below shows the percentage shares of the total expenditure on sports made by a country on various sports during 2019-2020. Study the pie chart and answer the question that follows.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3312986daed4ca8ea4e32f6cbfcfbdab8799ae533517b91717af1c8412b897fc.png] 

If the total amount spent on sports during 2019-2020 was ₹260 crores, then how much was spent on hockey?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A pie chart showing the percentage shares of the total expenditure,

On sports made by a country on various sports during 2019-2020

**Formula used:**

Quantity of the part = percentage × the total quantity of the whole.

**Calculation:**

According to the pie chart,

The percentage of the total amount spent on hockey is 15%.

15% of 260 = (15)/(100)× 260=39.

**∴ If the total amount spent on sports during 2019-2020 was ₹260 crores, then the amount spent on hockey is ₹39 crores.**
